$comment: Marketak end-to-end test fixture. 1 admin + 1 customer + 2 vendors + 1 rider. Every id is a deterministic uuid so re-runs are idempotent. Money is in piastres (EGP). Nothing here is secret; these are throwaway test identities.

admin.note: Only actor that may call admin_upsert_*. Insert into user_roles is what makes private.is_admin() true.

customer.note: profile_completed_at must be set via complete_profile_v1 or place_order_v1 raises PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.

vendor_staff.note: One staff row per vendor; the SAME user_id may staff both vendors. private.vendor_ids_for() is what authorises transition_order_v1.

rider.note: status must be one of offline|available|assigned|on_break. 'online' is REJECTED by riders_status_check. is_verified must be true or claim_order_v1 raises RIDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE. Location must be set or get_available_orders_v1 raises RIDER_LOCATION_REQUIRED.

fee_tiers.$comment: MANDATORY. compute_quote raises MISSING_FEE_TIER without a row for the vendor count. Must cover 1..max_vendors_per_order.

rider_pay_rules.$comment: One active row per city. Without it claim_order_v1 still runs but has_pay_rule is false and pay is base-only.

items.name: Margherita
items.$comment: CREATE FIXED, NOT SIZED. A row created in this transaction provably has no sizes yet, so creating it with pricing_mode=sized is refused with ITEM_SIZED_BUT_NO_SIZES. Seed order: create as fixed with base_price, add sizes, then PATCH {pricing_mode:'sized'}. base_price may equal the smallest size; it is discarded once the mode flips.

customer_address.label: home
customer_address.$comment: area_id MUST be set to the fixture area, and a delivery_zone MUST exist for that area, or quote_order_v1 raises NO_DELIVERY_ZONE.

vouchers.name: 10% off
vouchers.$comment: discount_value is BASIS POINTS: 1000 = 10.0%. An empty applies_to_vendor_ids array makes the code unusable - see KNOWN_BLOCKER below. Substitute both vendor uuids at seed time.

vouchers.name: Pizza only
vouchers.$comment: Demonstrates vendor scoping. Fails with VOUCHER_NOT_APPLICABLE on a cart containing only burger_house.

scenarios.$comment: Each scenario is an independent run. Reset between scenarios.

A_single_vendor.title: Customer orders from one vendor only

B_two_vendors.title: Customer orders from two vendors in one checkout

steps.note: creates ONE assignment covering both vendors
requires ALL sub_orders delivered first, else SUB_ORDERS_INCOMPLETE

C_driver_earnings.title: Rider's own view of what they earned

D_admin_payout_view.title: Admin sees what each vendor and the rider are owed

known_blockers.$comment: Superseded by known_blockers_remaining, which reflects post-036 state.

voucher_applies_to_vendor_ids_empty_arra.rule: if v_voucher.applies_to_vendor_ids is not null and not (v_voucher.applies_to_vendor_ids && v_vendor_ids) then reject VOUCHER_NOT_APPLICABLE
voucher_applies_to_vendor_ids_empty_arra.problem: The column is NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'. An empty array overlaps nothing, so every voucher created with defaults is rejected on every cart.
voucher_applies_to_vendor_ids_empty_arra.workaround: At seed time, populate applies_to_vendor_ids with the explicit vendor uuid list. The fixture uses the token ALL_VENDORS for this.
voucher_applies_to_vendor_ids_empty_arra.root_cause: No representation exists for 'applies to all vendors', including vendors created after the voucher.

vendor_rating_never_rolls_up.problem: No trigger on public.reviews updates vendors.rating_avg / rating_count. After inserting a 5-star review both stay 0.
vendor_rating_never_rolls_up.symptom: Every vendor shows as unrated forever.

assignment_created_by_rider_feed.problem: delivery_assignments rows are inserted by get_available_orders_v1, not by place_order_v1.
assignment_created_by_rider_feed.implication: The rider app must call get_available_orders_v1 before claim_order_v1, or claim raises ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND.

seed_order: 2. as admin: city -> area -> vendor x2 -> vendor_area x2 -> category per vendor
3. as admin: create every item as pricing_mode=fixed WITH base_price (sized is refused at create time: ITEM_SIZED_BUT_NO_SIZES)
4. as admin: add sizes / options / choices to the items that need them
5. as admin: PATCH {pricing_mode:'sized'} on the items that have sizes
7. as admin: vouchers (substitute the ALL_VENDORS token with the explicit uuid list)
8. as customer: complete_profile_v1 -> addresses row (area_id must match the seeded area)
9. as vendor_staff: vendor_staff row per vendor
10. as rider: riders row with status='available' (NOT 'online'), is_verified=true, location set
11. run scenario A, reset, run scenario B, reset

traps_encountered_and_hardened: riders.status='online' is rejected; allowed set is offline|available|assigned|on_break
rider must be is_verified=true or claim_order_v1 raises RIDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE
rider must share a location or get_available_orders_v1 raises RIDER_LOCATION_REQUIRED
delivery_assignments rows are created by get_available_orders_v1, NOT by place_order_v1; the rider app must open the feed before claiming
transition_order_v1 requires the sub_order_id for multi-vendor orders; passing NULL raises SUB_ORDER_NOT_FOUND
two-vendor order needs a fee tier row for vendor_count=2 or the quote raises MISSING_FEE_TIER
complete_delivery_v1 requires EVERY sub_order already delivered or it raises SUB_ORDERS_INCOMPLETE
cash collection channel must be 'cod' for cash payment; 'cash' raises PAYMENT_CHANNEL_INVALID
select id from sub_orders limit 1 and offset 1 are NOT guaranteed to differ; order by sequence to pick distinct sub_orders

vendor_rating_never_rolls_up.problem: No trigger on public.reviews updates vendors.rating_avg / rating_count. After inserting a 5-star review both stay 0.00 and 0.
vendor_rating_never_rolls_up.symptom: Every vendor shows as unrated forever.

no_voucher_admin_rpc.problem: Zero public functions match '%voucher%'. Vouchers can only be created by direct SQL.
no_voucher_admin_rpc.status: NOT FIXED - the voucher fix in 036 makes the scope usable, but there is still no dashboard path to create one

voucher_scope_fix.status: FIXED in 036_voucher_scope_fix - empty applies_to_vendor_ids now means ALL vendors
voucher_scope_fix.fixture_note: The ALL_VENDORS token in this file is still needed because vouchers have no admin RPC; seed time must write the explicit uuid list.

reset.$comment: Every actor uses a fixed uuid, so reset is a delete by id, not by pattern. Run inside a transaction that you roll back for read-only assertions.
